narrative_purpose: Show conchoidal fracture as an object: the smooth curved scar a crack leaves in a material with no crystal planes, and the impossibly thin edge it produces.
subject: A single freshly struck flake of black volcanic glass, roughly the length of a thumb, resting at a slight angle on dark stone with its inner face turned toward the viewer. That face is glassy and mirror-smooth, marked with a set of fine concentric curved ripples spreading outward from a single small point near one end, like the ripples on a still pond. A small cone-shaped dimple sits at that point. Along the lower margin the flake thins away until the edge is almost invisible, catching one thin bright highlight along its whole length.
scene: A dark stone work surface with a scatter of a few smaller glass chips and grey dust nearby, everything behind falling into deep void-indigo darkness.
camera: Very close macro three-quarter view, the flake filling most of the frame, shallow depth of field with the far chips soft.
light: A single low raking light from one side, grazing across the glassy face so the concentric ripples catch the light in curved bands, and picking out one continuous thin bright line along the thinned edge.
palette: Near-black volcanic glass with cool cyan-white specular highlights on its face and edge; deep indigo surroundings; a little cool grey dust.
style: Painterly naturalist specimen plate, a close material study, precise and reverent.
detail_level: Extremely high on the flake's rippled face and its thinning edge; everything else soft and dark.
composition: The flake laid diagonally across the frame with the strike point in the upper area and the thin edge along the lower, a broad region of plain dark surface at the upper right kept clear framed by deep negative space.
consistency_notes: The fracture face must be SMOOTH and CURVED with concentric ripples — never flat, faceted or crystalline. The edge should thin to near invisibility. Glass is near-black with cool highlights; no warm light in this figure at all.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no labels, no arrows, no scale bars or rulers, no crystal facets or flat fracture planes, no warm firelight, no 3D-render or photographic look, no cartoon style
